احتملوا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَمَلُوا (iḥtamalū) /iħ.ta.ma.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# اُحْتُمِلُوا (uḥtumilū) /uħ.tu.mi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# اِحْتَمِلُوا (iḥtamilū) /iħ.ta.mi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
